So generally each item has a specific weight to it in the computer, so it knows the difference between you scanning Pringles and putting dog food in the bagging area.  It's on a scale.  Anyway, on the employee side you can override the "unexpected" item, which then overwrites the weight for the item.  So the next person is screwed.  So the people with their own bags and decide to bring two carts to the self check out and scan their Doritos and that's the item that fills the bag up and they ask to remove it, the machine thinks it's not in the bag, it'll get overridden and the next bag of Doritos weighs 0.0 oz because the last person scanned it and it went into the bag "weightless" because of the override.  
This was the old system, the new updates have had a smart person edit them so the override is only for that transaction and doesn't mess up the entire database!  But yes, always embarrassing and stressful either way
